versions.changelog:
Version 1.1.0

- Added _meta.json file for enhanced metadata support.
- No changes to core functionality or user-facing behavior.

Initial release of the crypto-prices skill for live market data.

- Fetches real-time cryptocurrency and commodity prices via a local Python module.
- Supports both single and batch price lookups with detailed or minimal output.
- Covers major cryptos and precious metals; robust provider fallback chain.
- 60-second cache for quick repeat lookups with automatic rate limit handling.
- Enforces strict rules: never guess, never use web search for price info.
